title.en: Somalia in the East African Community
title.sw: Somalia katika Jumuiya ya Afrika Mashariki

text.en: Building peace, prosperity and a shared future through regional integration, free movement and sustainable economic growth.
text.so: Dhisidda nabad, barwaaqo iyo mustaqbal wadaag ah iyadoo loo marayo isku-dhafka gobolka, dhaqdhaqaaqa xorta ah iyo koboca dhaqaale ee waara.
text.sw: Kujenga amani, ustawi na mustakabali wa pamoja kupitia ujumuishaji wa kikanda, uhuru wa kutembea na ukuaji endelevu wa uchumi.

alt.en: H.E. President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud with the EAC Secretary General holding the Treaty for the Establishment of the East African Community
alt.so: Mudane Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo ay weheliyaan Xoghayaha Guud ee EAC iyagoo haysta Heshiiska Aasaaska Bulshada Bariga Afrika
alt.sw: Mhe. Rais Hassan Sheikh Mohamud pamoja na Katibu Mkuu wa EAC wakiwa wameshika Mkataba wa Kuanzisha Jumuiya ya Afrika Mashariki

title.en: Somalia is the 8th EAC Partner State
title.sw: Somalia ni Nchi Mshirika ya 8 ya EAC

text.en: A national gateway for integration progress, trade services, citizen mobility and Somalia's voice in regional institutions.
text.so: Albaab qaran oo loogu talagalay horumarka isku-dhafka, adeegyada ganacsiga, dhaqdhaqaaqa muwaadiniinta iyo codka Soomaaliya ee hay'adaha gobolka.
text.sw: Lango la taifa la maendeleo ya ujumuishaji, huduma za biashara, uhamaji wa wananchi na sauti ya Somalia katika taasisi za kikanda.

alt.en: President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud meets EAC leadership on Somalia's accession path
alt.so: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo la kulmay hogaanka EAC ee dariiqa xubinnimada Soomaaliya
alt.sw: Rais Hassan Sheikh Mohamud akikutana na uongozi wa EAC kuhusu njia ya uanachama wa Somalia

title.en: State Minister advances Somalia's integration at EAC high-level meetings
title.so: Wasiirka Gobolka oo horumarinaya isku-dhafka Soomaaliya ee shirarka sare ee EAC
title.sw: Waziri wa Nchi anaendeleza ujumuishaji wa Somalia katika mikutano ya ngazi ya juu ya EAC

text.en: H.E. Ali Mohamed Omar leads Somalia's engagement on the integration roadmap, passport alignment and regional cooperation across Partner States.
text.so: Mudane Cali Maxamed Cumar ayaa hogaaminaya ka-qaybgalka Soomaaliya ee khariidadda isku-dhafka, iswaafajinta baasaboorka iyo iskaashiga gobolka.
text.sw: Mhe. Ali Mohamed Omar anaongoza ushiriki wa Somalia kuhusu ramani ya ujumuishaji, kuoanisha pasipoti na ushirikiano wa kikanda.

alt.en: Somalia delegation at East African Community high-level meetings
alt.so: Waftiga Soomaaliya ee shirarka sare ee Bulshada Bariga Afrika
alt.sw: Ujumbe wa Somalia katika mikutano ya ngazi ya juu ya Jumuiya ya Afrika Mashariki
